claude-trio.evidence: Strongest reasoning in the family: open-ended planning, architecture and design from ambiguous asks, hard debugging of unreproduced failures, and deep review of finished changes. Slowest and most expensive. Text and code only; no image, audio, or video input or output.

Strong everyday coding: implements well-specified features and writes tests from a finished spec at moderate speed and cost; weaker than opus on open-ended design and hard debugging. Text and code only; no image, audio, or video input or output.

Fastest and cheapest: short classification, tagging, extraction into fixed fields, one-line summaries, and bulk mechanical edits from an exact list at high volume; weak at multi-step coding and design. Text and code only; no image, audio, or video input or output.

search-mix.evidence: Strongest reasoning: open-ended planning, design, hard debugging, and careful review. Slow and expensive. Generates text and code only; produces no embedding vectors, images, or audio.
Fast and cheap text model for short classification, tagging, extraction, and one-line summaries at high volume. Generates text only; produces no embedding vectors, images, or audio.
Embedding model: turns text into vectors for semantic search, clustering, and near-duplicate detection by meaning. Generates no text, so it cannot answer, plan, write, or classify on its own.
